notes: All Loa panels share valid CG15 mass/SFR/age/AV/FAGN and photometry eligibility; property changes are means, not medians.
Rank quarters are fixed in the parent mass-redshift bins before brightness selection; legacy GAT trace ranks unavailable.
Native class identities are source-specific; equal labels or ranks do not establish matched physical environments.
Means are quantized to .001 native units; counts and squared weights retain float32 precision.
No inferential uncertainty is claimed for interactive mixtures.
TNG log sSFR and log SFR have -14 floors for zero/very small SFR.
No interpolation across0.06-0.15; any combined sample remains an explicitly disjoint mixture.
